title: Adiponectin predicted effector genes (Sarsani V et al. 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays predicted effector genes for plasma adiponectin levels, from the study:

A cross-ancestry genome-wide meta-analysis, fine-mapping, and gene prioritization approach to characterize the genetic architecture of adiponectin.
Sarsani V, et al.
HGG Adv. 2024 Jan 11;5(1):100252. doi: 10.1016/j.xhgg.2023.100252.
PMID: 37859345

The authors performed a trans-ancestry GWAS meta-analysis for adiponectin levels in over 46,000 individuals and developed the Gene Priority Score (GPScore) method to prioritize genes at associated loci. The GPScore method considers distance between the lead GWAS variant and the transcription start site of a gene along with the results of 11 different gene prioritization strategies and generates a combinatorial score representing the likelihood that a gene is an effector gene for adiponectin levels. The table below lists 30 genes with high GPScore values across the 22 loci that were associated with adiponectin in the trans-ancestry analysis.
